build_wpo_networks: create WPONetworks with policy head, critic head, and torso for a DM Control task
init_params_wpo: initialize WPO network parameters and LSTM state from an environment spec and random key
make_unrollable_network: build an UnrollableNetwork with a configurable RNN core module and optional feedforward layer
create_identity_rnn: create an IdentityRNN core with identity-initialized hidden-to-hidden weights and ReLU activation
build_gru_with_skip: build a GRU module with skip connections that concatenates inputs to outputs
